title: feature: ISA Bit Layout
description:
Migrate and complete the ISA doc to this repo.
Create the bit layout for the 32 word size ISA.
Output should be a markdown file in the ./docs directory.
The contents should include the ISA with all of the instructions we've enumerated so far at least partially described and the aforementioned bit table.
Instruction types should include R-type, I-type, and J-type binary code.
